messages:
mira_marketing: Quick compact asset request for upcoming webinar on inference economics. Need a reusable mini-kit for slides, registration page, and social.
mira_marketing: Deliverables: hero (1600x900 static + 3s loop GIF), 3 micro-tiles (1080x1080, 1200x628, 320x480), a 4-frame micro-storyboard (1080x1080 each), inbound swimlane routing diagram (1200x600), and a single-page speaker pacing timeline. Include SVG + PNG for each and alt text.
leo_design: Got it. Two colorways (brand blue + neutral). Any hard copy or benchmarks to call out?
mira_marketing: Core copy below. Bench blurb: "Sample workload: conversational routing. Median latency ~60ms; caching + batching reduces unit cost ~2.6x (typical)." Rita, please review comparative language.
anya_growth: For banners, we need paid and organic CTAs. Paid banners: "Register now" (use stronger accent). Organic: "Learn more." Also add a 600x200 and 1:1 crop (1080x1080).
tom_prod: Routing details for swimlane: registration form -> lead scoring -> premium queue (score >= 80) OR standard queue -> AE handoff. After 48h unassigned -> SDR. Visible CRM tag: "inference_use_case". Keep external labels generic (premium/standard).
rita_legal: Flag acknowledged. Send final headline and benchmark phrasing for review; I can turn around within 24h. Please mark any internal numbers "illustrative."
figma-bot: Uploaded: figma://launch-mini-kit/2799997777 (preview: https://figma-preview.example/2799997777) :white_check_mark:
leo_design: I'll post light/dark hero comps + routing sketch by Mon 09:00 PT and attach alt text in figma notes. Priority order: 1) hero GIF + static, 2) routing diagram, 3) micro-tiles, 4) storyboard frames, 5) pacing timeline.
mira_marketing: Thanks — tag me on uploads. One-note: keep PNG exports <200KB when possible and ensure CTA contrast >= 4.5:1.
anya_growth: Also request a tiny methodology slide (single column) for a supporting tweet thread.
leo_design: Adding that. Any localization?
mira_marketing: Only EN for now. If everything looks good we'll request JA next week.
rita_legal: I'll review once hero copy and benchmark sentence are posted.
mira_marketing: Headline candidates: 1) "Predictable inference. Measured costs." 2) "Serve models reliably at scale 0 lower unit cost." Use #1 for paid, #2 for organic.
leo_design: Copy noted. Uploading first-pass thumbnails soon.
